d: Platinum white hair flows in a long, wavy style reaching the ground, accompanied by a long, thick beard of the same shade. The eyes are a soft, pale pink with a serene, closed-lid expression. The face appears elderly and mature, paired with a slender build. The outfit consists of a floor-length navy blue robe with gold Celtic knotwork on the sleeves, layered over a cream-colored undergarment and a red and gold decorative stole. Visible accessories include gold hoop earrings and a tall golden staff topped with a glowing cyan crystal; a small white and gold owl with dark wings perches on the arm. BODY COLOR: Pale beige LEGS: Plantigrade with closed footwear.
